# FDG8043

> CONSIDER using the “ReadOnly” prefix in names of read-only collections if a corresponding writeable collection might be added or already exists in the framework.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.3.4.1 Naming Custom Collections.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a writable collection might be added later is not in the code.

## From the book

For example, a read-only collection of strings should be called `ReadOnlyStringCollection`.
